summary: Saturn over the natal Moon's own sign (janma Shani) is one of its hardest transits in the classical texts: illness, losses, separation from family, humiliation and tiring travel. It is the middle, peak phase of Sade Sati.
common_outcomes: loss of money and of comforts
separation from relatives or living away from home
rare_outcomes: a death in the family for which the native performs the last rites [maraka: text predicts death of a relative]
danger from poison or fire, confinement or harassment (Brihat Samhita)
[maraka: text predicts danger to life] when Saturn is in the 1st from the Moon (Phaladeepika 26.33)

by_area.personality: Mind under pressure; humiliation and loss of confidence (Brihat Samhita 104.39). Popular modern accounts call this the most intense part of Sade Sati.
by_area.career: Loss of position is listed among the dangers of Saturn in the 1st from the Moon (Phaladeepika 26.33).
by_area.health: Disease (Phaladeepika 26.22); fatigue from journeys on foot (Brihat Samhita 104.39).
by_area.relationships: Separation from kinsmen; living among friends in a foreign place (Brihat Samhita 104.39).
by_area.family: Loss of sons and a bereavement requiring the native to perform funeral rites (Phaladeepika 26.22; Brihat Samhita 104.39).

strengtheners: (softening) Saturn exalted or in its own sign while transiting: does no harm (Phaladeepika 26.31)
(softening) aspect of a benefic on transiting Saturn (Phaladeepika 26.30)
(softening) many bindus in Saturn's ashtakavarga for the sign (Phaladeepika 26.41)
(softening) Saturn yogakaraka, lagna lord, Moon-sign lord, exalted or in a trine natally (Nirikhi Krishna Bhagavan)
weakeners_or_cancellations: (intensifying) Saturn debilitated (Aries) or in an enemy's sign (Phaladeepika 26.32)
(intensifying) a Saturn or other malefic dasa running (Kurczak; Nirikhi Krishna Bhagavan)
(intensifying) no or few bindus in Saturn's ashtakavarga for the sign (Raman)
lagna_or_context_notes: Classical gochara is counted from the natal Moon's sign; Phaladeepika 26.1 says only the Moon's lagna counts for transits. P.S. Sastri's note to Uttara Kalamrita ch. 6 (verse on annual results) records other views: count from the lagna up to age 33, from the Moon for the next 33 years and from the Sun after that, or from the stronger of lagna and Moon. Modern authors treat transits as secondary to the natal chart and dasha: Frawley gives them about one-third weight in judging a period; Raman (HPA ch. 34) says the birth chart, dasha, ashtakavarga and vedha must be blended; Brihat Samhita 104.46 says benefic results scale with the running dasha and the person's station. Saturn's transit gives the 2.5-year (triennial) results (Raman). This is the peak (janma) phase of Sade Sati; see sade_sati/peak.

summary: Saturn in the 8th from the Moon (ashtama Shani, the 'big Dhaiya') is one of its worst transits in the classical texts: losses, illness, separation from family and friends, and hardship.

rare_outcomes: loss of children (Phaladeepika) [maraka: may be read as death of a child]

by_area.relationships: Loss of friends (Phaladeepika 26.22); separation from wife (Brihat Samhita 104.44).

lagna_or_context_notes: Classical gochara is counted from the natal Moon's sign; Phaladeepika 26.1 says only the Moon's lagna counts for transits. P.S. Sastri's note to Uttara Kalamrita ch. 6 (verse on annual results) records other views: count from the lagna up to age 33, from the Moon for the next 33 years and from the Sun after that, or from the stronger of lagna and Moon. Modern authors treat transits as secondary to the natal chart and dasha: Frawley gives them about one-third weight in judging a period; Raman (HPA ch. 34) says the birth chart, dasha, ashtakavarga and vedha must be blended; Brihat Samhita 104.46 says benefic results scale with the running dasha and the person's station.
